method: Official-domain search followed by page open and relevant section lookup; no model request or authentication material accessed

scope: Provider request_max_retries and stream_max_retries are documented configuration settings
Custom provider names must avoid reserved builtin identifiers
Documented settings are not proof of the installed CLI effective behavior
references.verification: documentation inspected; effective CLI behavior unverified

scope: Custom local providers can omit credential settings and leave requires_openai_auth false
Actual credential acquisition and provider acceptance are separate runtime concerns
references.verification: documentation inspected; no account credentials or credential helpers used

scope: The command network proxy has a different boundary from client model and authentication traffic
Endpoint policy alone does not prove separation across tools, model traffic and authentication
references.verification: documentation inspected; actual Codex channel boundary unverified

scope: Response objects and streaming examples carry provider-reported model and reasoning fields
Response fields are observed data; no backend attestation is established by their presence
references.verification: documentation inspected; real provider values unobserved
references.inspection_method: HTML exceeded web tool size; Markdown web retrieval rejected content type; fetched official .md via urllib to ignored local workspace, inspected fields/examples

scope: The response reasoning.effort reports the request-level setting; configuration updates can select different effort later
Reported effort does not establish actual internal reasoning expenditure
references.verification: documentation inspected; no request or configuration update sent

non_claims: Configuration presence is not effective retry proof
Provider-reported model fields do not authenticate remote model implementation
Offline local transport fixtures are not live model observations
